meta.ci: percentile 95% (2.5th and 97.5th percentiles, numpy linear interpolation)
meta.leaf_rules: rust = abaxial face; American leaf spot = mean of the two faces
meta.reference_grade: rust: cut-points 0.5/5/20% on reference severity; leaf spot: annotator's visual grade
meta.healthy_test_coverage: 21 healthy rust-pack test leaves are present locally; the paper used 54 (33 not in the local pack)

integrity.note: Own-disease val/test rows of per_image.csv (one row per image and model: n_distinct_images images x 3 models = n_rows); reference labels rebuilt from the packs with run_inference.load() rules; predicted counts recomputed from the saved class maps.

val_vs_test.note: Diseased leaves only (rust 21 val / 21 test; leaf spot 55 / 55). test_minus_val CIs: independent leaf resamples of the two sets. Validation is not a fully independent check: it was used for checkpoint selection (and, for the rust CNNs, the healthy-leaf false-positive penalty).

definitions.severity: letterbox space (as in the evaluation); native-resolution grades as a check
definitions.rust_leaf: abaxial face; healthy rust-pack leaves reported separately
definitions.leaf_spot_leaf: mean of the two faces; visual grade = annotator's grade (split CSV)

split_independence_tests.note: Monte Carlo permutation test of the Pearson chi-square statistic (labels permuted across leaves), p = (1 + #{chi2* >= chi2}) / (1 + 10,000). Descriptive check that splits share one grade mix.

collection_dates.site_note: Sarchi: rust (2026-08-19). EARTH (Guacimo): American leaf spot (2026-06-21, 2026-06-28) and the healthy rust-pack leaves (2026-06-12, 2026-06-15, 2026-06-22).

roya.note: All rust leaves (train, val, test) were collected on a single date (2026-08-19); a date-clustered bootstrap is not possible for rust, and between-date variation cannot be estimated. Only the leaf bootstrap is reported.

scheme.leaf: resample 55 leaves with replacement (same resamples as the val/test table)
scheme.date_cluster: two-stage: resample the 2 dates with replacement, then resample leaves with replacement within each drawn date (n_d leaves)
scheme.date_stratified: dates fixed; leaves resampled within each date (n_d leaves)

ojo.caveat: Only two collection dates exist for leaf spot; a cluster bootstrap with two clusters estimates between-date variance from two values and is not a reliable basis for inference. It is reported as a sensitivity illustration only.

rust_faces.note: Rust diseased leaves (21 per split). For each face rule the reference severity and the reference grade use the same rule (adaxial: adaxial face; both: mean of the two faces; IoU = mean of the face IoUs). qwk_vs_abaxial_reference_grade compares the rule's predicted grade with the paper's (abaxial) reference grade. Abaxial = the paper's primary rule (repeated for comparison). CIs: leaf bootstrap with the same resamples as val_vs_test (streams roya/test and roya/val), so the abaxial CIs equal those in val_vs_test.

class_frequencies.note: Pixel counts summed over training images after letterboxing to 1024 x 1024 (the training input: the kernels letterbox labels with NEAREST and pad with background). Flip/rotation augmentation does not change class counts. Background includes the letterbox padding.
